app.name: Alyte
app.tagline: A calm place for your laboratory history

onboarding.title: Your history, kept close.
onboarding.body: No account is required. Alyte starts locally and keeps your records on this iPhone.
onboarding.localBody: Your reports and intake history stay on this iPhone unless you choose an optional cloud action.
onboarding.historyBody: Import Lab Reports, review the extracted Measurements, and compare compatible measured changes over time.
onboarding.cloudBody: Before anything leaves this iPhone, Alyte explains what is sent and why.
onboarding.measuredBody: Imported values keep their source. Review them before they shape a measured trend; general context never becomes a diagnosis.
onboarding.privacyBody: Reports stay on this iPhone. Source observations remain distinct from confirmed Measurements, and Alyte does not diagnose or predict future values.
onboarding.modelChoiceBody: Alyte currently uses one verified model to organize report observations on this iPhone.
onboarding.modelChoiceFact: Free download · stays on this iPhone
onboarding.modelPrepareBody: Download and verify the model before entering Alyte. The model is never loaded during onboarding.
onboarding.modelReadyBody: The verified model is ready on this iPhone. Alyte will load it only when a report needs local extraction.
onboarding.readyBody: Your private laboratory history starts here. Import a report whenever you’re ready.
onboarding.completionFailure: Alyte could not save this step. Your model is still ready; try continuing again.
onboarding.modelBody: Alyte needs this verified model to structure report observations. It stays on this iPhone.
onboarding.contextualModelBody: Alyte needs this verified model to continue reading your report on this iPhone.
onboarding.modelSpace: Storage requirement: keep at least 6 GB free while preparing it
onboarding.modelFailureOffline: A network connection is needed. Reconnect and try again.
onboarding.modelFailureSpace: There is not enough free space. Make room, then try again.
onboarding.modelFailureChecksum: The download did not match the reviewed file. Nothing was activated.
onboarding.modelFailureVerificationRequired: Alyte needs to verify the model again before using it. Try again.
onboarding.modelFailureNetwork: The public model source could not be reached safely. Check your connection and try again.
onboarding.modelFailureInterrupted: The previous download was interrupted. Your downloaded bytes are saved.
onboarding.modelFailureIncompatible: This iPhone cannot use this model pack. Update Alyte or choose a supported device.
onboarding.modelFailureUnavailable: Local model support is unavailable in this build. Install the Alyte iOS app and try again.
onboarding.modelFailureGeneric: The model could not be prepared. Your local records are unchanged.
onboarding.modelSetupFailureOffline: Reconnect to the internet, then try again.
onboarding.modelSetupFailureSpace: Free at least 6 GB on this iPhone, then try again.
onboarding.modelSetupFailureChecksum: The downloaded file did not match the reviewed file, so it was not activated.
onboarding.modelSetupFailureVerificationRequired: Alyte needs to verify the downloaded model again. Try again.
onboarding.modelSetupFailureNetwork: The public model source could not be reached safely; check your connection and try again.
onboarding.modelSetupFailureInterrupted: The download stopped; try again to continue preparing the model.
onboarding.modelSetupFailureIncompatible: This iPhone cannot use this model pack; update Alyte or use a supported device.
onboarding.modelSetupFailureUnavailable: Local model support is unavailable in this build; install the Alyte iOS app and try again.
onboarding.modelSetupFailureGeneric: The model could not be prepared; try again.
onboarding.modelKeepOpen: Keep Alyte open until the download and verification finish. It may pause if you leave Alyte or lock your iPhone.
onboarding.modelPartialSaved: A partial download is saved at {progress}%.
onboarding.modelSetupPartialSaved: The previous download stopped with {progress}% saved.
onboarding.modelCancelFailure: The download could not be cancelled. Try again while it is still running.
onboarding.modelCancelDisclosure: Download cancelled. Choose the model again when you are ready.
onboarding.modelSetupCancelDisclosure: Download cancelled. Start again whenever you are ready.
onboarding.modelChecking: Checking this iPhone for the verified model…

home.title: Home
home.emptyTitle: Your laboratory history, in one place.

home.reportRowHint: Open this Lab Report in Labs.
home.recordRowHint: Open this Lab Record in Labs.

home.continueReportHint: Open this Lab Report in Labs to continue its existing workflow.

labs.title: Labs
labs.emptyBody: Your imported reports and measured history will appear here.
labs.reportImportBody: Choose a PDF from Files or one report image from Photos. Each image becomes one Lab Report. Alyte keeps the Original Report on this iPhone before any later processing.
labs.reportPickImages: Choose one report image from Photos
labs.reportImporting: Copying the Original Report into protected local storage…
labs.reportImportError: Alyte could not finish importing this report. The protected source remains available when possible.
labs.reportImportNoSourceError: Alyte could not retain this report source. Delete this import and choose the report again.
labs.reportImportCancelled: Import was cancelled. No temporary source was kept.
labs.reportImportMultipleImages: Choose one report image at a time. Each image becomes one Lab Report.
labs.reportImportInvalidImage: The selected item is not a report image.
labs.reportWrongPassword: That password did not unlock the PDF. The protected Original Report is retained so you can retry.
labs.reportMalformed: This file could not be inspected as a readable PDF.
labs.reportPasswordBody: Enter the password for {filename}. Alyte uses it only for this import session and does not save or upload it.
labs.reportRetainedBody: This Original Report is immutable, protected, and excluded from iCloud Backup. Structured Measurements are separate from this source document.
labs.reportNoSourceRetryBody: This import has no protected source to retry. Delete it, then choose the report again.
labs.reportPreviewError: The protected source could not be previewed. It may be unavailable, corrupt, or no longer readable.
labs.reportViewerError: The protected source could not be opened. It may be unavailable, corrupt, or no longer readable.
labs.reportViewerCancelled: Opening the protected source was cancelled.
labs.reportViewerPasswordError: The password was not accepted. Try again or close this viewer.
labs.sanitizedEditorBody: Choose pages and review every redaction before creating a new derivative. The Original Report stays unchanged on this iPhone.
labs.sanitizedEditorExactBody: Preview is rendered from the verified derivative bytes that a later upload or export would use. Failed verification never appears here.
labs.sanitizedDiscardBody: Your Original Report stays unchanged. Unsaved redaction and page edits will be discarded.
labs.sanitizedEditorPreview: Render and preview exact Sanitized Report
labs.sanitizedEditorLoadError: The Sanitized Report editor could not open.
labs.sanitizedEditorEditError: That redaction edit could not be applied.
labs.sanitizedEditorVerificationError: Alyte could not verify this derivative. It remains unavailable for upload or export; the Original Report is unchanged.
labs.sanitizedEditorVerificationFailureBody: Verification failed. Retry or cancel to keep the Original Report unchanged.
labs.sanitizedEditorEditFailureBody: Your last edit was not applied. Continue editing or cancel.
labs.sanitizedEditorViewerFailureBody: The document view could not be refreshed. Continue editing or cancel.
labs.sanitizedEditorDeleteError: The Sanitized Report could not be deleted. Try again to finish cleanup.
labs.reportRetryBody: The source remains on this iPhone. Retry local inspection when you have the PDF password or after a temporary failure.
labs.extractionModelRequired: Prepare the verified local model before starting automated extraction.
labs.extractionPrivacyRequired: Local extraction reads the protected Original Report on this iPhone.
labs.extractionSourceError: The protected Original Report changed or is unavailable. Import it again before retrying.
labs.extractionRecognitionError: Alyte could not finish processing this report.
labs.extractionNoMeasurementsError: Alyte could not identify credible lab values to review.
labs.extractionAlreadyConfirmed: Local extraction is already confirmed for this report. The existing Lab Records remain available below.
labs.extractionIntro: Alyte found measurement-shaped results on this iPhone. Review the exceptions, then confirm the complete report.
labs.extractionCompactIntro: Review each proposed Measurement. Open any row to compare its exact source, correct it, or skip it.
labs.extractionProgressBody: Alyte is reading this report on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded.
labs.extractionProgressModelRequired: Prepare the verified on-device model to continue.
labs.extractionProgressPasswordError: That password did not unlock the Original Report. Try again; the password is not saved.
labs.extractionProgressSourceError: The protected Original Report changed or is unavailable. Import it again before retrying.
labs.extractionProgressCancelled: Processing was cancelled before it finished.
labs.extractionNoMatchesBody: Change the search or show all Measurements.
labs.extractionSourceNotice: OCR and deterministic parsing run locally. No account or network is needed.
labs.extractionDateMissing: Collection date is missing. Enter it on each row if you know it; Alyte will not use the report-issued date.
labs.extractionOriginalRegion: Original Report · page {page} · stored source region
labs.extractionSanitizedPageRegion: Sanitized Report · page {page} · stored source region
labs.extractionEditorSubtitle: Correct the extracted result or skip it.
labs.extractionDecisionRequired: Choose preserve, skip, or resolve for {count} remaining row(s).
labs.extractionConfirmationNoIncluded: Include at least one Measurement to confirm.
labs.extractionLoadError: The local Extraction Draft could not be loaded.
labs.extractionEditValueError: Enter a numeric, bounded, categorical, or free-text value.
labs.extractionRequiredFieldsError: Add a label and an unambiguous value before including this Measurement.
labs.extractionSaveError: Your change was not saved. Your edits remain here so you can try again.
labs.extractionDiscardBody: This Measurement has edits that have not been saved.
labs.extractionSanitizedPreviewError: The verified Sanitized Report could not be opened. Return to the privacy workspace and verify it again.

labs.reportDeleteConfirm: Delete this Original Report? Any linked Lab Records remain, with their source marked as user-deleted.
labs.reportLoadError: The Lab Report could not be loaded.
labs.reportUnavailableBody: This Lab Report is no longer available in local history. Return to continue reviewing your records.
labs.reportRowHint: Open this Lab Report to review its source and local status.
labs.recordRowHint: Open this Lab Record to review its Measurements.
labs.historyRowHint: Open this Biomarker history to review compatible Measurements.
labs.errorBody: Alyte stopped before saving anything because local protection was unavailable.
labs.historyErrorBody: Alyte could not read the protected local Measurements. Nothing was changed.
labs.historyNotFound: This Biomarker history is no longer available.
labs.historyEmptyBody: Confirmed compatible Measurements will appear here when a Lab Record includes this Biomarker.
labs.historyChartDescription: Only compatible measured values with known collection dates are connected. Other states remain visible below as context.
labs.historyNonPointNotMeasured: Not measured in this Lab Record
labs.historyNonPointBounded: Bounded result; not plotted as a point
labs.historyExplanationPending: A reviewed explanation will appear here after catalogue content review.
labs.historyGeneralGuidanceBody: This is separately labelled, population-level information. It does not replace the laboratory interval or act as a personal target.
labs.historyGuidanceDisclosureHint: Reveal the threshold, applicability, catalogue, review, and source details for this General Guidance.
labs.historyGuidanceContextUnavailable: No applicable General Guidance is shown because this view does not have the complete context needed to select it. Alyte does not infer sex, jurisdiction, specimen, or purpose.
labs.historyGuidanceNoMatch: No applicable General Guidance was found for the complete context provided.
labs.historyGuidancePendingReview: General Guidance is unavailable until the catalogue content is reviewed for publication.
labs.historyNoGuidance: No applicable General guidance is available for this context.

labs.recordDateMissingLabel: I do not know the collection date

settings.title: Settings
settings.privacySubtitle: Local records, files, export, and deletion
settings.appLockSubtitle: Face ID, Touch ID, or device passcode
settings.modelStorageSubtitle: See status or reclaim model storage
settings.privacyIntro: Alyte works without an account. Your local health records stay on this iPhone, and local health files are excluded from iCloud Backup.
settings.privacyUnavailable: Local storage details are unavailable. Your records were not changed.
settings.privacyExportSubtitle: Choose what to share from this iPhone
settings.modelStorageBody: The required on-device model is free to use. It is stored in protected Application Support and excluded from iCloud Backup. Removing it never removes Lab Reports, Lab Records, Measurements, drafts, charts, or exports.
settings.modelStorageSource: Source: google/gemma-4-E2B-it → ggml-org/gemma-4-E2B-it-GGUF · Google / ggml-org · Apache-2.0
settings.modelStorageSpace: Storage requirement: keep at least 6 GB free while preparing it
settings.modelStorageDeleteConfirm: Remove the local model? Existing local history remains available, but new automated extraction will ask you to prepare it again.
settings.modelStorageDeleted: Model storage removed. Existing local history remains available.
settings.modelStorageError: The model storage action could not finish. Nothing else was changed.
settings.modelStorageKeepOpen: Keep Alyte open until the download and verification finish. It may pause if you leave Alyte or lock your iPhone.
settings.modelStoragePartialSaved: A partial download is saved at {progress}%.
settings.modelStorageCancelError: The download could not be cancelled. Try again while it is still running.
settings.modelStorageCancelled: Download cancelled. The model is still available to prepare when you are ready.
settings.modelStorageRemoved: Model removed. Existing local history is unchanged.
settings.supportIntro: Contact support without attaching health records. Diagnostics are optional and previewed before you share them.
settings.contactSupportSubtitle: Opens Mail with no automatic attachment
settings.supportMailBody:
Hello Alyte Support,

What can we help with?

I have not attached health records or media.

Thank you
settings.diagnosticsIntro: This summary contains only app, platform, coarse capability, and failure-category information. It cannot include health records, IDs, filenames, paths, or raw errors.
settings.faqLocalBody: No. The local laboratory-history journey works without an account or network connection.
settings.faqBackupBody: Alyte stores local health files inside protected app storage and excludes them from iCloud Backup.
settings.faqExportBody: Structured records are always included. Original Reports, Sanitized Reports, and Intake Images are optional and start off.
settings.faqDeleteBody: Deletion is not reversible. Alyte shows the exact categories and counts before the native destructive confirmation.
settings.mailUnavailable: Mail is not available on this iPhone. You can contact support from the Alyte support website.
settings.exportSelectBody: Structured data is always included. Media is off by default and stays on this iPhone until you explicitly choose it.
settings.exportMediaUnavailableBody: Alyte could not verify local media counts. Retry before choosing media for this export.
settings.exportPreviewBody: The selected files will leave Alyte protection when you share this archive. Share only with a destination you trust.
settings.exportWarning: Shared exports are no longer protected by Alyte.
settings.exportProgress: Preparing a protected archive on this iPhone.
settings.exportDoneBody: The system share sheet handled the archive. Alyte removed its temporary export files.
settings.exportCancelledBody: Temporary export files were removed. Your local records were not changed.
settings.exportUnavailableBody: This iPhone cannot open the system share sheet right now. Temporary export files were removed; your local records were not changed.
settings.exportFailedBody: Alyte removed temporary files where possible. Your local records were not changed; try again.
settings.deleteIntro: Choose one local category. Alyte shows what will be deleted and what will remain before a native destructive confirmation.
settings.deleteReportsSubtitle: Remove source reports and their sanitized derivatives
settings.deleteRecordsSubtitle: Remove records, Measurements, and correction history
settings.deleteEventsSubtitle: Remove events, components, images, and local jobs
settings.deleteMediaSubtitle: Remove report and intake files; retain structured records
settings.deleteAllSubtitle: Remove local reports, records, intake, jobs, and export artifacts
settings.deleteConfirmBody: This cannot be undone. Alyte will remove the selected local health data and verify its protected files.
settings.deleteSuccessBody: The selected local health data and its protected files were removed. Your app and non-health preferences remain.
settings.deleteFailureBody: Alyte kept the durable operation and preserved the current database state where cleanup did not finish.

appLock.title: App Lock
appLock.intro: Protect Alyte with Face ID, Touch ID, or your device passcode. The lock only controls access to this app; local records and optional cloud account state stay independent.
appLock.enableSupporting: Authenticate when Alyte opens or the grace period ends
appLock.graceSupporting: A shorter period asks again sooner after you leave Alyte
appLock.note: A neutral screen always covers Alyte in the app switcher. Turning on or off the lock asks for your current device authentication.
appLock.settingsError: That change could not be saved. Your existing app-lock setting is still in place. Try again.
appLock.faceIDPermission: Alyte uses Face ID to unlock your local Alyte history when you choose app lock.
appLock.readError: Alyte could not read its local protection setting. Nothing is shown until you try again.
appLock.shieldError: Alyte could not prepare its privacy shield. Try again to continue.
appLock.cancelled: Authentication was cancelled. Alyte remains locked.
appLock.lockout: Authentication is temporarily unavailable. Try again when your device allows it.
appLock.unavailable: Device authentication is unavailable or changed. Try again or check your device settings.
appLock.failed: Alyte could not verify your device authentication. Try again.

snap.title: Snap
snap.body: Snap means you consumed this now. The image and a pending Intake Event are saved on this iPhone before you leave.
snap.cameraPermissionDeniedBody: Allow camera access in Settings to capture an Intake Image. You can still choose a photo or log the event manually.
snap.referenceTitle: Reference analysis does not log consumption
snap.referenceBody: This path is for a package or label you want to inspect. It will not create an Intake Event. Cloud reference analysis will be added behind the same disclosure boundary.
snap.captureFailed: The Intake Image could not be saved. Nothing was added to your timeline.
snap.localModeBody: No account, entitlement, or network is needed. The image stays on this iPhone.
snap.cloudModeBody: After consent, this image may leave the iPhone for temporary processing. It can remain queued offline and can be cancelled before upload.
snap.cloudDisclosureTitle: Before an Intake Image leaves this iPhone
snap.cloudDisclosureBody: Alyte would send this exact Intake Image to its processing service to identify visible contents. It is used for this analysis, deleted after processing, and a short-lived encrypted result may return to this device. You can keep capture local instead.
snap.cloudDisclosureAccept: I understand and enable cloud analysis
snap.cloudQueued: Queued locally; upload has not started

intake.deleteConfirm: Delete this event and its components? This cannot be undone.
